items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for go-live and security-sensitive releases because fleet-doctor has no run or findings, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, broader TLS evidence, data exposure controls, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. This is not evidence of compromise or certification. Decision: keep private-launch and security-sensitive release gates unchanged; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not create duplicate security work.

Conditional security approval for the existing queued CTA refinement only after capacity is released. Scope must remain limited to CTA hierarchy, adjacent disclosure, responsive layout, keyboard focus, contrast, tap targets, destination integrity, and validation. Require deterministic tests, build, link validation, smoke, accessibility checks, rollback evidence, and confirmation of no new routes, dependencies, telemetry, credentials, permissions, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not admit duplicate work or clear fleet security gates.

SearchWoot remains private and blocked for beta or full launch. Security evidence is incomplete across access control, secrets, isolation, release/deploy controls, dependencies, TLS, monitoring, incident handling, data exposure, and disclosure readiness. Retain the existing read-only evidence bundle and do not send outreach, change production, enable tracking, add credentials, or add dependencies.
